title: Khao Yai Marathon 2027 Review: Racing Beside Thailand's First National Park
meta_description: Khao Yai Marathon 2027 review: January 10 in Pak Chong -- near Thailand's first national park, a UNESCO World Heritage forest complex since 2005.
dek: Set for 10 January 2027 in Pak Chong, this marathon runs near Khao Yai National Park -- Thailand's first national park, established in 1962 and a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2005.
verdict: The B-Quik Khao Yai Marathon runs near a genuinely significant natural landmark: Khao Yai National Park, Thailand's first national park, established in 1962 and now part of the UNESCO-listed Dong Phayayen-Khao Yai Forest Complex since 2005. Five distances from 2K to the full marathon give it the widest range of any race in this batch, suiting everyone from families to serious marathoners. Organised by Race Up Work Co., Ltd. -- the same organiser behind the Scenic Marathon series covered at Krabi, Chiang Mai and Nakhon Phanom elsewhere in this research -- giving it credible operational backing.

sections.heading: Racing Near Thailand's First National Park
paragraphs: The Khao Yai Marathon offers five distances -- 2K, 5K, 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon -- in Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima. [1] Khao Yai National Park was established in 1962 as Thailand's first national park, declared by royal proclamation, and covers 2,166 sq km -- the country's third-largest park. [2]

sections.heading: A UNESCO World Heritage Forest Complex
paragraphs: Khao Yai became an ASEAN Heritage Park in 1984, and on 14 July 2005 was proclaimed a UNESCO World Heritage Site under the name Dong Phayayen-Khao Yai Forest Complex, together with neighbouring national parks in the Dong Phaya Yen Mountains. [2] Running in this area gives the marathon a genuinely globally significant natural backdrop, though development pressure from nearby luxury hotels and golf courses has become a real conservation concern for the park itself.

sections.heading: The Widest Distance Range in This Research Batch
paragraphs: Five distances from a 2K up to the full marathon give this race the broadest accessibility of nearly any event covered in this research -- suiting families and complete beginners alongside serious distance runners in one event. [1]

sections.heading: A Familiar Organiser
paragraphs: Race Up Work Co., Ltd. organises this race -- the same team behind the Scenic Marathon series covered at Krabi, Chiang Mai and Nakhon Phanom elsewhere in this research batch. [1] That multi-region track record gives this event genuine operational credibility even without independent Khao Yai-specific reviews yet.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a genuinely broad-range race near one of Southeast Asia's most significant natural heritage sites appeals, the Khao Yai Marathon on 10 January 2027 is a strong pick, run by an organiser with proven experience across multiple Thai destinations. Watch for registration to open.

faqs.answer: It's Thailand's first national park, established in 1962, and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005 as part of the Dong Phayayen-Khao Yai Forest Complex -- a genuinely globally recognised natural landmark. [2]
